craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra-adbhuta of tended glory through impurity — the Lord in wandering (v14 absent in data too: edition numbering gap, not a defect; L4 follows the L3 set). Confession kept quoted (so-I-am); stains + Lord in one breath; smīti parse per UNC. Rejected: (a) unquoting → killed: quote performs confession. Read aloud: IN-com-PLETE — SO-i-AM … WORLD-lord.

lines: Incomplete — 'so I am, incomplete' — by assorted stains defiled,
māyā's, atom's, deed's by name — yet all-pervading too, world-Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: apūrṇo 'smīti vividhair malaiḥ | māyīyāṇavakārmākhyair vyāpako 'pi jagadvibhuḥ

reads_against.argmap: What does the incomplete confess? → Incompleteness confessed, defiled, yet all-pervading Lord.
c1_essence: Tended means; Lord tends; release-glory proceeds.
God's five, self's five; delusion the difference.
Expansion sung capable; contraction called wanderer.
Withdrawn grace in oneness; manifesting named veiling.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of tended glory; adbhuta of actor-assumed stages; adbhuta of shining-impure; karuṇa-vīra of confessed Lord; vīra of mirrored acts; vīra of named states; adbhuta of willing māyā; karuṇa-adbhuta of graced veiling; adbhuta of jewel-near-yet-clod
